text: Illustration. A different car, April 20th account
In April, an empty Waymo was swept into Salado Creek.
observed: Samples 16.0 to 16.8 s of option b. Eye-level creek, camera held. The SUV, sunk to its window line with a reflection and a white wake curl, drifts left past the fixed tree trunk. Right of the wake a pale vertical line drops from the ledge into the water. The pale stone ledge spans the full width with a long near-horizontal lower edge against the water. This matches option a's creek framing at the same times.
